abilities.description: Takes 25% less direct damage from the front (a 120° arc). Side and rear hits deal normal damage; damage over time is unaffected.
abilities.name: Guarded Stance

abilities.description: After a 1-second wind-up, deals 160% attack physical damage to his target and 80% to other enemies within 1 hex of that target. Stuns the primary target for 0.6 seconds.
abilities.name: Bone Cleaver

abilities.description: At 40% HP, permanently abandons Guarded Stance and gains 40% attack speed for the rest of the fight.
abilities.name: Last Stand

abilities.description: Every 3 seconds, enemies within 1 hex take 15% attack magic damage.
abilities.name: Demonic Presence

abilities.description: After a 1-second wind-up, slashes a 120° forward cone up to 2 hexes deep for 170% attack physical damage. Direction locks at the start of the wind-up.
abilities.name: Demonic Cleave

abilities.description: At 40% HP, cleaves also ignite up to 3 hit hexes for 2 seconds. Enemies standing on a burning hex take 20% attack magic damage each second. Overlapping fire refreshes its duration without stacking damage.
abilities.name: Infernal Ground

abilities.description: Normal attacks apply a 3-second bleed dealing 10% attack physical damage per second. Maximum 2 stacks; a new hit at the cap refreshes the oldest stack.
abilities.name: Rending Claws

abilities.description: Locks onto an enemy with no adjacent allies, preferring the farthest eligible unit; otherwise chooses the farthest enemy. After a 0.6-second wind-up, lunges to a free adjacent hex and deals 150% attack physical damage.
abilities.name: Reaper Pounce

abilities.description: At 40% HP, alternates Pounce with an interruptible 2-second channel: 4 slashes each deal 35% attack physical damage to the 3 closest enemies. Stun or death cancels remaining slashes.
abilities.name: Scythe Storm
